integrity: Every peripheral vertex automatically satisfies strong-odd parity because its neighbors use distinct colors. The hub requirement is equivalent to positive odd occurrence of every peripheral color. A discrete parity projector applied to the product of elementary symmetric polynomials yields the exact coloring count. The uniform minimum follows from odd column multiplicities and a finite degree-balancing construction. A standalone checker recomputes direct proper strong-odd colorings and the signed formula independently.
scientific_limitations: The exact polynomial counts named-palette proper strong-odd colorings on clique bouquets with at least two nonempty blades; it is not a complexity bound.
The closed chromatic-number corollary is for equal blade sizes only.
Finite direct enumeration is limited to specified small bouquets; unrestricted claims use the mathematical proof.
The 2026 block-graph optimal-coloring algorithm was available at abstract level, not in full text, leaving a residual comparison risk for the scalar corollary.
title: Strong-odd coloring polynomial of clique bouquets
